# How Do I Automate Key and Access Control for Guests?


You automate key and access control by letting access codes generate and send automatically as check-in approaches, and revoke automatically at checkout. On **Jestor** , this connects reservation status to automations and, when applicable, API integrations with smart lock systems.


Manually managing keys and access codes across a growing property portfolio is a repetitive administrative task with a genuine security risk if something gets missed.


## What manual access control risks


- Someone needing to remember to generate and send access codes manually
- Codes not revoked in time after checkout, creating a security risk
- No centralized record of which codes are active on which property
- Inconsistency between properties managed by different people


## How access automation works


- Date-triggered automations can generate and send access information before check-in
- Integrations via **open API** or **webhooks** can connect to smart lock systems, if available
- Checkout can automatically trigger access code revocation
- A centralized record shows access status across every property


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- Date-based automation removes the dependency on someone remembering manually
- Webhooks and open API allow connection to lock systems that expose their own API
- The centralized record reduces the risk of forgotten or unrevoked codes
- This connects naturally with the automated check-in and checkout flow


Manual access control Automated access control


Manual generation and revocation Triggered automatically by reservation status


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does this work with any smart lock system?** It depends on the system exposing an API or webhook for connection. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Is the code revoked automatically after checkout?** This can be configured as part of the automation, depending on the integration available.


**Does this require a developer to configure the lock integration?** For custom integrations with specific lock brands, generally yes.
